parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station T-17 (survey area T). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 21.0 | 3.05 | 3.05
2 | 251.5 | 15.26 | 18.31
3 | 420.6 | 1.34 | 19.65
4 | 513.2 | 0.88 | 20.53
5 | 496.2 | 17.89 | 38.42
6 | 4573.6 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this sounding curve as AKQH-type.

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: T-17
Curve type: AKQH-type
Aquifer depth: 18.31 – 38.42 m
Recommendation: Drill to a total depth of approximately 42–45 m to fully exploit the weathered and fractured basement zone overlying the fresh bedrock. Screen the productive intervals between 18.3 m and 38.4 m, and seat the casing firmly into the competent basement rock below 38.42 m.
